verdict.rationale: No vendor documentation claims Fedora Workstation is optimized for older hardware or extends device lifespan; the only performance-related docs item is a generic 'performance mode' toggle unrelated to legacy hardware. Community evidence actually reports the opposite experience, with fedora-comm-19 stating Wayland has been 'nothing but trouble... on older hardware' and fedora-comm-8 noting freezes under RAM pressure, so there's no support for this specific story.
